english.title: Operate/use radio transmitter etc in manner likely to adversely affect airport systems - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated or used

(A)_[a radio transmitter,]_
(B)_[something capable of radiating electrical interference, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..),]_

in such a way as to adversely affect, or be likely to adversely affect the operation of communication, navigation or other systems at Liverpool John Lennon Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(b) and 3(6) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationoperated or useda radio transmitter OR something capable of radiating electrical interference,in such a way as to adversely affect, or be likely to adversely affect the operation of any communication, navigation or other system at the airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
